offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures dental implants, clear aligners, orthodontic appliances and dental consumables and equipment. Sells to dental professionals and dental labs through direct sales and distributors, and makes the products in its own facilities or through contract manufacturers.

primary_products.value: dental implants; clear aligners; orthodontic appliances; dental consumables; dental equipment

customer_segment.value: B2B: dentists, dental practices, orthodontists, dental labs

revenue_model.value: product sales: dental implants, aligners, orthodontic products and consumables sold to dental professionals

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: makes dental implants, orthodontic products and consumables from raw materials, sold to dental professionals; brand owner: owns and markets dental brands sold through distributors and direct sales

geography_served.value: global: sells in North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific and other regions worldwide

specialization.value: related lines: dental implants, orthodontics, aligners and dental consumables and equipment sold to the same dental customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams calling on dental practices and large dental groups; distributors / dealers: third-party dental supply distributors in many countries

regulatory_exposure.value: high: medical devices such as implants and aligners need FDA clearance or approval and EU medical device rules (MDR)
